Ingwaz — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᛜ
inner work quiet preparation nearly ready don't rush it

Upright meaning

Ingwaz is a 'it's nearly time' rune. Something is complete or completing inside you — you're getting ready for a significant next step, even if it doesn't look like much is happening on the outside.

Think of it like a seed under the ground. There's a lot going on — it just hasn't broken the surface yet. This is not the time to force it or rush it. Let the process finish.

When the moment comes to emerge, you'll know. And you'll be ready.

Ingwaz doesn't reverse. When it's done, it's done.
